single.rationale: REVVITY shows stabilizing revenue growth (3.7% YoY) after three years of decline, strong FCF generation (17.8% margin), and improving operational efficiency through restructuring. However, compressed margins from tariffs ($20M net impact), high leverage relative to profitability (P/E 50x despite low ROE of 3.3%), and continued headwinds in Life Sciences offset these positives. The company warrants monitoring as restructuring benefits materialize, but current valuation and margin pressures don't justify immediate deep research.

team.thesis: Revvity is navigating a post-acquisition consolidation phase after three years of revenue decline from $3.3B to $2.9B (-4.8% CAGR), with net income dropping from $693.1M to $241.2M and return on equity deteriorating to 3.3%, but the company maintains strong free cash flow generation of $509.4M (17.8% margin) while actively deleveraging from $3.2B to $2.6B in long-term debt and reducing share count
